module: Third-party library lustache: core of the Mustache engine. The renderer parses a template (`parse`) into a token tree (text, variables, `#` sections, `^` inverted sections, `>` partials, triple braces `{`/`&`, delimiter change `=`), compiles it into a function (`compile`) and renders it with a view (`render`). Compiled templates are cached. `{{x}}` values are HTML-escaped; `{{{x}}}` and `{{&x}}` are not.
notes: The file returns the `renderer` table (local variable); the auto page says "global renderer" but the code does not create a global. An instance is obtained with `renderer:new()` (fields cache, partial_cache, tags = {"{{","}}"}).

Sections: an array table (contiguous indices 1..n) is iterated; another table becomes the context; a function receives (raw_section_text, render_function); any other truthy value renders the section as is.

Bug: in nest_tokens, the test `not section.value == token.value` is evaluated as `(not section.value) == token.value`; a section close that does not match the open is therefore not detected (only the "Unopened section" and "Unclosed section" cases are).

`_partial` reads `self.partials[name]` and compiles the partial; partials are memoized by name in partial_cache (the cache is not invalidated if the partials table is changed without calling clear_cache).
Methods prefixed with `_` (_section, _inverted, _partial, _name) are internal, called by the compiled code.

new.desc: Creates a renderer instance (empty caches, {{ }} delimiters).

render.desc: Renders the template `template` with `view`. Compiles and caches the template on the first call. If `partials` is provided, it is stored as the partials table. Returns "" if `template` is nil. Error if called with a dot (`self` is a string).

view.desc: Data; a table is wrapped in a Context.

compile.desc: Compiles a template (string) or a list of tokens into a function `function(view) -> string`.

tokens.desc: Raw template (parsed by parse) or token tree.

originalTemplate.desc: Original text, needed to extract the raw text of function sections.

parse.desc: Splits the template into a token tree. `tags` is an array of two strings (opening and closing delimiter, mustaches by default). Raises an error "Unclosed tag at <pos>", "Unopened section" or "Unclosed section".

returns.desc: Token tree {type, value, startIndex, endIndex, tokens?}.

clear_cache.desc: Clears the cache of compiled templates and that of partials.

_section.desc: Renders a section `{{#name}}...{{/name}}` according to the value of the name (array: iteration; table: sub-context; function: call with the raw text; otherwise truthy value). Internal.

_inverted.desc: Renders an inverted section `{{^name}}` only if the value is nil, false or an empty array. Internal.

_partial.desc: Renders the partial `{{>name}}` from self.partials (compiled then cached); "" if the partial is absent. Internal.

_name.desc: Renders a variable: resolves the name (calls the value if it is a function, with the view), converts to string (nil becomes "") and HTML-escapes if `escape` is true. Internal.

returns.desc: Text (with, when escape is true, a second return value: the number of gsub replacements).
